title: Grace by the Sea
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Grace by the Sea”, a luxury 6-bed, 6 full & 1 half-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 16 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Game Room, & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Brand New Construction - Private Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $60 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Game Room - Located in Seacrest Beach West on a Quiet Private Road - Over 6,000 square foot - Tower with Direct Views of the Gulf - 6 seater Golf Cart & 6 adult Bikes Welcome to Grace by the Sea, a stunning new luxury retreat in West Seacrest Beach where elevated coastal design, exceptional outdoor living, and effortless access to the best of 30A come together for an unforgettable getaway. This beautifully appointed home offers spacious gathering areas alongside private retreats, creating the perfect balance for your time at the beach. Soaring ceilings, warm wood details, designer lighting, and an abundance of natural light give the home a relaxed yet refined atmosphere from the moment you arrive. At the heart of the main home, the open-concept living, dining, and kitchen areas were made for gathering. The gourmet kitchen features an expansive island, beautiful stone countertops, premium appliances, and plenty of room for preparing everything from casual breakfasts to memorable family dinners. Just beyond, comfortable living spaces invite everyone to settle in after a day along the Gulf. Outside, Grace by the Sea truly becomes its own private resort. The expansive courtyard centers around a large private pool surrounded by covered porches and comfortable lounge areas. Spend sunny afternoons poolside, enjoy dinner outdoors, fire up the grill, or gather around the outdoor fireplace as the sun goes down. Multiple balconies and covered outdoor spaces provide even more places to enjoy the coastal breeze. When it is time to unwind, the home offers an exceptional collection of sleeping accommodations. Multiple king bedrooms provide luxurious spaces for adults, while the bunk room gives younger guests a space of their own. Spa-inspired bathrooms, vaulted ceilings, thoughtfully selected furnishings, and beautiful finishes continue the home's elevated design throughout. A separate carriage house with its own king suite, living area, and kitchen provides additional privacy and is ideal for grandparents, couples, or anyone wanting a little extra space. And when you're ready to explore, the sugar-white sand and emerald waters of the Gulf are just moments away. A six-seat golf cart and six adult bikes make it easy to head to the beach or spend the day discovering the restaurants, shops, and neighboring communities along scenic 30A. Whether your days are spent at the beach, cruising 30A, or simply enjoying the pool without ever leaving home, Grace by the Sea offers the space, privacy, and thoughtful luxury to make your next coastal getaway one you'll want to return to year after year. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor - Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Separate - Bathroom w/ Shower Only Second Floor - Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Separate - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Bunk Room w/ Two Twin over Twin Bunks Carriage House - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only
